newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures close higher across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures close higher across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher across the board on Wednesday on technical buying from individual investors, traders said.
Prices were 290 to 450 yen higher, with the benchmark March 1998 contract up 370 yen at 16,210 yen. The day's volume was 58,772 lots.
Technical buying emerged from the opening, despite the lower Chicago market overnight, traders said.
The spot March contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.08-1/4 per bushel at 0840 GMT, compared with Tuesday's close of $3.08-1/2.
The CBOT soybean futures spot March contract was at $8.55 at 0845 GMT, up from $8.51-3/4 at Tuesday's close. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk (+81-3-3432-7391)
